node.title: change \n to \t
node.author: yueli711
node.doctext:
Hello, I have file here. I want to change file 1.fa to file 1.txt. Thanks in advance for great help! Best, yue

open(IN1, "1.fa") || die "Cannot open this file"; @lines = ; $i = 0; for (@lines) { $lines[$i]=~s/\nA/\tA//g; $lines[$i]=~s/\nT/\tT//g; $lines[$i]=~s/\nC/\tC//g; $lines[$i]=~s/\nG/\tG//g; $lines[$i]=~s/\nN/\tN//g; $thislines[$i]=$lines[$i]; print $thislines[$i]; $i++; } open(OUT, ">1.txt") || die "Cannot open this file"; for $thisline(@thislines){ print OUT $thisline;} close(OUT); close(IN1); 1.fa >1 AGTCGTAGCAT >2 TGAGCTACG >3 GGCATAGN >4 CGCACNCAGCTACACC >5 NGATAGCTACA 1.txt >1 AGTCGTAGCAT >2 TGAGCTACG >3 GGCATAGN >4 CGCACNCAGCTACACC >5 NGATAGCTACA
